'''Sweet berries''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Health Boost}}. Eaten raw, they heal {{Value|Sweet Berries|heals}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/sweet_berries.json}}</ref> Cooked into [[Sweet Berry Mash|sweet berry mash]], they make [[Sweet Berry Jam|sweet berry jam]] and the [[Sweet Berry Danish|sweet berry Danish]], which raise maximum health by 2 and 4 hearts.

== Obtaining ==

=== Harvesting ===
Sweet berry bushes drop and give the pack's sweet berries when harvested or broken. Harvesting a bush gives 2 or 3 berries whether or not it is fully grown: unlike vanilla, which gives 1 or 2 from a bush that is not fully grown, the pack's harvest table has no check for the bush's age.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/harvest/sweet_berry_bush.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

=== Replacement ===
Sweet berries without the pack's tooltip are replaced with the pack's version when they enter the inventory of a player who is not in Creative mode, one at a time.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/remove_vanilla_items/sweet_berries.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sweet berries heals {{Value|Sweet Berries|heals}}.

Picking up sweet berries unlocks sweet berry mash. They are also used raw in the [[cake]], [[mead]] and the secret [[Sweet Berry Toast|sweet berry toast]].
